subject: QBR action funnel & ownership — Acme Health prep
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-06-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QBR action funnel & ownership — follow ups

Team,

Thanks for the sync this morning. Putting a short action funnel for the Acme Health QBR so execs have a single roll-up ahead of Monday's readout:

- Owner / ask / ETA:
  * Marissa: consolidate product asks + ACs into the shared doc by Fri 2027-06-11 (sheet attached).
  * Karthik: confirm rollback & mitigation plan for model rollout (include SLI thresholds and tested revert step) by Tue 2027-06-08.
  * Kimberly: procurement checklist + SOW redline status by Wed 2027-06-09.
  * Jonas: engagement health metric (lead touchpoints + NPS signal) by Thu 2027-06-10.

Priority notes:
- Karthik's rollback plan is blocking the exec decision — if we don't have clear revert criteria, SLT will delay sign-off.
- Kimberly's procurement items are gating contract signature; legal needs the redline inputs.

I've attached qbr-action-tracker.csv with the initial rows — please update the 'status' and 'blocking' columns as things move. After Marissa consolidates the ACs we'll loop in Maria Lopez (Acme Health) for a short acceptance criteria sync.

Proposed cadence: daily 15-min stand for the next 3 business days (optional) and a single slide roll-up for Monday.

Thanks,

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Product Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachments: qbr-action-tracker.csv (spreadsheet, 12KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR action funnel & ownership — follow ups

Thanks Vivek — quick note from infra/serving perspective.

I will own the rollback plan. Current thinking (will formalize by Tue):
- Trigger conditions: >3% request error rate OR sustained latency p50 > 400ms for 10m window.
- Revert step: route traffic to previous pinned model version + invalidate prefix cache (testing window: 10m).
- Smoke tests: run synthetic baseline against canary after revert (5-min window).
- Communication: automatic alert to eng-oncall + manual notify to product + SLT page.

Open ask: need clarity on acceptance gating from product (Marissa) — specifically which feature flags can be disabled vs which require full revert. If product can confirm per-AC which flags are non-blocking, that shortens the plan.

Will also attach a short runbook draft by EOD Monday.

Date: 2027-06-06T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR action funnel & ownership — follow ups

Vivek / all — I've started consolidating the product asks and acceptance criteria into the shared doc (link below). High level items I'm tracking for Acme Health: 

- Feature A: include batch export, ACs: export contains last 30 days, schema v2, automated validation hook.
- Feature B: latency target tightened to p95 < 900ms for heavy queries; flag gating allowed for async degrades.
- Feature C: fuzzy matching thresholds to be parameterized (product owners to confirm safe defaults).

I've highlighted the rows where we need explicit rollback vs feature-flag fallback — Karthik, please check the flagged rows and confirm if rollback is required or if a flag toggle suffices.

Link: https://drive.google.com/document/d/1aB_example_link (QBR ACs / acceptance matrix)

I'll schedule a 30-min sync with Maria for Tue 2027-06-08 10:00am PT to walk the acceptance matrix after it's updated; Maria, please let us know if that time works for you.

Marissa
Product Lead, Integrations | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: QBR action funnel & ownership — procurement note

Quick procurement update — attaching the procurement-checklist.pdf with the current outstanding items. Two items to call out that are likely to push the signature timeline if not addressed ASAP:

1) SOW redlines: Acme legal requested a clause change on data retention; legal needs final language from product/legal by Wed 2027-06-09.
2) KMS key flow: procurement needs confirmation whether customer-managed keys will be required for this account (ProcureCo is copied).

Action requested:
- Marissa: confirm the retention language preference and whether ACs require adjustments to retention policy.
- Jonas: confirm the engagement metric details — procurement references usage commitments in SOW.

ProcureCo, please review the attached checklist and confirm the timeline you can support for contract finalization.

Thanks,

Kimberly
Sr. Manager, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the updates — quick escalation and next steps: 

- Karthik: please prioritize the rollback runbook and include concrete SLIs/triggers; I will escalate to SLT today for their eyes.
- Kimberly: thanks for the checklist — I'll ping Legal to prioritize the retention clause.
- Marissa: confirm the ACs by EOD Monday so we can run the acceptance readout with Acme on Tue.

I'll set a short exec readout slot for 2027-06-09 4:00pm PT if we have the updated rollup; if not, we'll push the QBR to the following week.

Very appreciative — this one has some execution risk but the plan is straightforward if we hit the deadlines.

Vivek
